From: Elena Morris <elena@stellarsys.com>

Date: Mon, 09 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Renewal — proposed capacity uplift and SLA changes

Hi Aisha,

Thanks again for the demo last week. We’re ready to move forward with the renewal, but we need to formalize two updates before legal signs:

1) Capacity reclassification — our usage patterns have grown and we want to move 800k tokens/mo from the Standard tier to a new Premium pool with guaranteed burst QoS.
2) SLA changes — we require a 99.9% uptime SLA for production endpoints and a 30% credit for sustained incident windows >3 hours.

Could you send an updated order form and proposed MSA amendment/redline? Procurement (cc’d) wants to review pricing, proration for the mid-cycle change, and any term changes. We’re okay moving to an 18-month term if it helps with the pricing band.

I’ve copied Samir from procurement for calendar availability.

Thanks,
Elena
Elena Morris
Head of Platform Engineering — StellarSys
elena@stellarsys.com

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>

Date: Thu, 12 Nov 2026 15:20:00 -0800
Subject: RE: Draft redlines — Order Form + pricing proration (v1)

Thanks Ben — quick legal read below (high level):

1) Proration — add explicit formula (DailyRate = MonthlyFee / 30) to avoid disputes. Add a one-sentence example for clarity.

2) SLA credit cap — customer requests a 30% credit for >3hr incidents. We are willing to keep the 30% credit but need to limit aggregate credits to 100% of monthly fees per rolling 12 months. Add that cap in the SLA Exhibit.

3) Liability and indemnity — StellarSys asked to increase liability cap. We should keep the standard capped at the greater of $1M or 3x fees paid in prior 12 months. If they insist higher, need sales exec approval for exceptions.

4) Term change — moving to 18 months is OK but we should add an early-termination clause with pro-rata repayment of any committed discount. Ben/Vanessa: please confirm pricing math for the early-termination scenario so I can add a clause template.

I’ll prepare an MSA amendment clean and tracked version (MSA_Amendment_termext.docx) and drop inline comments.

Rishi Malhotra
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference
